user_constraints: Pertahankan style game asli dan layout desktop yang sudah baik. Fokus mobile, animasi, generator, misi, level akun.
precedence: Preservation of the user's existing pastel style supersedes the prior subagent's unrelated dark-gold redesign and invented 4x4 tiles.

visual_system.cards: 2px ink border, 3px offset shadow, 16-24px rounded corners
visual_system.dark: Preserve existing optional dark mode via club CSS variables

mobile.navigation: Five bottom tabs outside scrollable page, hidden during games
mobile.board: ResizeObserver fitted to available area; never shrink HUD or clip footer
mobile.layout: Readable labels, fluid grids, safe areas, 390px overflow verification

animations.hierarchy: 2x2 to horizontal or vertical dominoes to distinct 1x1 pairs
animations.effects: Full-footprint path rings, split image halves, spring children, bounded theme-colored shards, stars and rings
animations.accessibility: Honor reduced motion; static equivalent feedback

assets.strategy: Use existing complete local art, contain critical images, SVG lucide controls

missions: Five balanced daily slots, varied weekly goals, persisted previous progress, Permen plus XP, direct play actions
progression: Shared authoritative XP awards from all games and missions, account titles and progress; separate from game level
testing: Consolidated final functional pass plus required desktop/mobile visual checks
